about: Sector Nine gun finishes (window.S9GunSkins). weapon = gun id or "all" (cross-weapon collection). look = runtime material settings: tex files assets/tex/gunskins/<tex>_a.jpg (albedo) _m.jpg (R rough, G metal, B height) _e.jpg (emissive); sc = pattern tiles per metre (tri-planar); trim/metal/grip = how the gun's secondary parts are recoloured; mode = animation (0 none, 1 emissive flow, 2 full flow, 3 pulse, 4 twinkle, 5 glitch, 6 swirl, 7 sweep); fx = accent geometry (fins | holo | duck) from assets/models/gunskins/<weapon>.gltf.json. Generated by render/gunskins/texgen.py.
